clips.title: The story
paras: Nori Pridedrift sends you across Coldridge Valley with hot mornbrew for Durnan Furcutter. The drink must reach Anvilmar before the mountain cold takes its heat.

Nori Pridedrift has just sent a delivery to Grelin Whitebeard. Now he has no time to carry another fresh cup to Anvilmar before it freezes into slush. Rather than leave his customer waiting, Nori asks a swift traveler to brave the snow with the mornbrew.

Durnan Furcutter waits inside Anvilmar's warm mountain hall and is particular about his refreshments. Chilled mornbrew will not do. A hot cup gives the weary dwarf a needed break from his duties, and Nori expects his favorite mug back in one piece.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Gah! I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first. I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

You look fast. Maybe you can make it. This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going. Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.
Thanks, friend, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter. You have something for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah good, now this will hit the spot. Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
